audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase reason is template text keyed to 'GNAR!'s cooldown'. Gnar's transform is driven by the Rage bar, not by a cooldown you can wait out.
audit.why: Rage Gene fills from attacking and being attacked and forces the swap when it caps — the ability cooldown on GNAR! is irrelevant to when Mega arrives.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around the Rage bar as the real tell, Boomerang Throw's 1100 range and Hop's 22s escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2-item stage said only 'your pattern is at full power' and the first-item spike was tied to the wrong cooldown.
audit.why: Your spike is Lich Bane used while he is still in mini form; his is any moment Rage caps with you inside Wallop range.
audit.corrected: phases[5] and phases[6] now key both to the Rage bar rather than to an ability cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit split was never stated: mini Gnar out-ranges you 1100 to 550 and Hop resets off you, while Mega brings Wallop's stun and GNAR!'s knockup into terrain.
audit.why: The kit file gives Boomerang Throw 1100 range on 16s at rank 1, Hop 22s at rank 1 with a dash, Wallop hard CC on 7s, and GNAR! knockup plus terrain. Wallop and GNAR! are what actually kill you; the boomerang only chips.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[0].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t with the real numbers.

audit.why: Boomerang Throw 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Hop 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, Wallop 7s flat, GNAR! 90/60/30; your E is 16s and W 20s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Get out-ranged' was described as diving with no shroud and no energy.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title, using the 1100-to-550 range gap.

edits.before: Mini kites you — shroud his combo, dodge Mega. Akali wins the GNAR! cooldown windows.
edits.after: Mini kites you — watch the Rage bar, not a cooldown. Akali wins the window before Mega lands.

edits.before: Close on mini and shroud Mega. Track GNAR! before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Close on mini and shroud Mega. Read the Rage bar before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Gnar contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Boomerang Throw reaches 1100 to your 550 kunai, so mini Gnar chips you for free. Farm and refuse the range war.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Gnar's GNAR! is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Take it while he is mini and his Hop is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gnar must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online: E-mark mini Gnar, dash the angle, and Shroud the boomerang's return leg before it clips you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around GNAR!'s cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Hop is 22s at rank 1 and is his only exit — commit inside that hole, never while it is up.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gnar's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but a capped Rage bar brings Wallop's stun and a knockup into terrain — never fight into a full bar.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on GNAR!'s cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight now, while he is still in mini form.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Gnar carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and mini Gnar dies in a rotation, but Mega front-lines teamfights — pick him before the fight starts.

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. Shroud it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - The Rage bar, not GNAR!'s cooldown, is what tells you Mega is coming — read it before every step. - Hop (22s at rank 1): his only exit, so commit inside it. - Wallop (7s): the stun that starts every Mega kill.

edits.before: Q Gnar at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q mini Gnar at 550, E-mark and dash the angle once Hop is spent, then Shroud the boomerang return.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Stepping up on a near-full Rage bar — Mega lands mid-trade and Wallop stuns you flat out.

edits.before: Q Gnar at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Mini has 1100 range on you and no stun — that form is the only one you should be duelling.

edits.before: Gnar wastes GNAR! (Mega Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Vanish as Mega lands and his Wallop stun finds only empty smoke.

edits.before: That is Gnar's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Boomerang Throw reaches 1100 to your 550 — chasing that poke is how you arrive low.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Wallop stuns and GNAR! pins you to a wall — never take it raw.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: He out-ranges you by 550 in mini form, so only trade once your E has closed that gap first.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun): His Mega all-in. Shroud it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Read the Rage bar, not a cooldown. Hop (22s) is his exit; Wallop starts every Mega kill on you.

notes: The full layer treated GNAR! as a trackable cooldown ('Track Gnar's GNAR!'), which is misleading — the transform is Rage-driven and the ultimate is only castable in Mega form. I replaced that framing with the Rage bar everywhere I could reach. focus.text still reads 'Gnar GNAR! (Mega Stun)' and is not on the writable path list, so it still points at the wrong tell and needs a hand fix.
